verdict.rationale: Org-wide policy enforcement is a fair question for a 2FA authenticator that markets team code sharing. However, the evidence only shows per-user controls: an individual can set a custom lock screen or FaceID lock and password-protect their own backups. Nothing documents an admin console or any way to enforce app lock, restrict export, or mandate strong master passwords across members' apps.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app
